How to Apply for Affordable Housing;

To apply for any of our affordable housing units, please follow the steps below:

  1. Download the Application Form

  2. Complete the Application

  3. Mail the Completed Application To:
     Tax Solute Consulting
     670 Flushing Avenue, Suite 316
     Brooklyn, NY 11206


Please note: some units might also be listed on alternative platforms. 

Units indicated as 'On Hold' signify that applications have been received and are currently undergoing review.





📝 Need help? Call us at: 718-650-6570

*Listings are updated regularly. Please apply early to be considered under HPD’s first-come, first-served policy. Tax Solute supports HPD-approved Marketing Agents in the marketing and intake of affordable housing units.*
